_comment: Curated marketplaces and the plugins we install from each. After cloning this repo, run `bash .claude/scripts/install-plugins.sh` to bulk-install the recommended set, or manually `/plugin marketplace add` + `/plugin install`. Per Claude Code v2.1.x — plugins update automatically and are sandboxed.

marketplaces.name: claude-plugins-official
marketplaces.description: Anthropic's official plugin marketplace. 150+ vetted plugins, auto-update enabled.

marketplaces.name: claude-plugins-community
marketplaces.description: Anthropic-curated community plugins. Auto security-scanned, pinned to SHAs.

marketplaces.name: superpowers-marketplace
marketplaces.description: Jesse Vincent's curated marketplace. Pairs with the Superpowers skill framework (TDD, debugging, verification, plans, code review, parallel agents, git worktrees).

marketplaces.name: wshobson-agents
marketplaces.description: Cross-harness marketplace: 83 plugins, 191 agents, 155 skills, 102 commands. Tiered model assignment.

marketplaces.name: dream-skill
marketplaces.description: Overnight memory consolidation skill — REM-sleep-style 4-phase pass (orient → gather → consolidate → prune). 24h auto-trigger via Stop hook.

marketplaces.name: token-optimizer
marketplaces.description: Cost-reducer plugin v5.7.0. 141 tests, 5 lifecycle hooks, live dashboard, auto-checkpoint + restore across compactions, zero deps, zero telemetry.

marketplaces.name: claude-mem
marketplaces.description: Tier 3 episodic memory — hybrid SQLite + ChromaDB + 3-layer MCP search. Worker on localhost:37777. Install via `npx claude-mem install`.

recommended_plugins.name: superpowers
recommended_plugins.why: Core agentic discipline — TDD, brainstorming, writing-plans, executing-plans, systematic-debugging, verification-before-completion, subagent-driven-development, dispatching-parallel-agents, using-git-worktrees, finishing-a-development-branch, requesting-code-review, receiving-code-review, writing-skills. Single highest-leverage install.

recommended_plugins.name: skill-creator
recommended_plugins.why: Official Anthropic meta-skill for authoring skills with eval loop. Use when extending this harness with new skills.

recommended_plugins.name: mcp-builder
recommended_plugins.why: Official 4-phase MCP server creation: Research → Design → Implement → Validate. Use when building a new MCP server.

recommended_plugins.name: frontend-design
recommended_plugins.why: Forces distinctive design direction (brutal-minimal / maximalist / retro-futuristic / etc.) before coding. Bans AI-slop aesthetics (Inter, purple-on-white gradients, generic Space Grotesk).

recommended_plugins.name: webapp-testing
recommended_plugins.why: Python Playwright scripts + with_server.py multi-server lifecycle helper. Pairs with .claude/skills/browser-e2e (MCP-driven) for full coverage.

recommended_plugins.name: doc-coauthoring
recommended_plugins.why: Official Anthropic doc generator. Replaces hand-rolled doc skills; pairs with the doc-writer agent.

recommended_plugins.name: chrome-devtools-mcp
recommended_plugins.why: Official Chrome DevTools MCP wrapper — debugging, network, performance, Lighthouse.

recommended_plugins.name: playwright
recommended_plugins.why: Official Playwright MCP — browser-driven E2E via accessibility snapshots and deterministic refs.

recommended_plugins.name: github
recommended_plugins.why: Official GitHub MCP plugin — issues, PRs, code search, Actions.

recommended_plugins.name: sentry
recommended_plugins.why: Official Sentry MCP plugin with the sentry-mcp subagent.

recommended_plugins.name: dream
recommended_plugins.why: Auto-consolidate memory overnight. 4-phase pass keeps MEMORY.md under 200 lines. Wired to Stop hook for 24h cadence.

recommended_plugins.name: token-optimizer
recommended_plugins.why: Cost reducer with live dashboard, compaction-survival checkpoints, command-output compression.

optional_plugins.name: spec-kit
optional_plugins.why: GitHub's spec-driven workflow. Aligns with this harness's eight phases. Install if you want the canonical /speckit.* commands alongside our /specify, /plan, etc.

optional_plugins.name: designer-skills
optional_plugins.why: Owl-Listener designer-skills — 91 skills across 9 design plugins. Install if you ship a frontend.

optional_plugins.name: marketing-skills
optional_plugins.why: Corey Haines's 41 marketing skills with cross-references. Vertical-specific.

optional_plugins.name: web-scraper
optional_plugins.why: yfe404/web-scraper — auto-picks strategy and scaffolds Apify Actors in TypeScript (Crawlee under the hood).

skip_list.name: ui-ux-pro-max-skill
skip_list.reason: Heavyweight mega-skill (161 rules + 67 styles). Anthropic's frontend-design is leaner and ships with the official marketplace.

skip_list.name: ruflo
skip_list.reason: Hive-mind / byzantine-consensus theater. Performative cosplay around shared-memory writes. Skip wholesale; cherry-pick patterns only if needed.

skip_list.name: everything-claude-code / ECC
skip_list.reason: 3946 files, 246 skills, 14 IDE mirror dirs, 1.5KB inline node bootstrap per hook. Kitchen-sink. Borrow patterns (instinct/context-budget/prompt-defense) but don't install.

skip_list.name: openclaw
skip_list.reason: Multi-channel personal assistant gateway — wrong layer for coding orchestration.

skip_list.name: hermes-agent (nousresearch)
skip_list.reason: Competitor agent runtime, not a Claude Code plugin. Conceptually note s6-overlay supervision in RESEARCH.md only.

skip_list.name: oh-my-claudecode (OMC)
skip_list.reason: Heavy abstraction that replaces Claude Code semantics with its own. Borrow patterns (XML CLAUDE.md tags, git trailers, keyword-detector) but don't install the framework.

skip_list.name: caveman
skip_list.reason: Meme skill. We already have a Concise output style that achieves the same brevity without the bit. Borrow the auto-clarity escape-hatch pattern in our skill-writing template.
